answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable copper-denominated bond before its votes count, and cap voting weight per bond rather than per identity. Spinning up a sybil fleet then costs one full bond per clone, so a single deposit can't echo across thousands of fake agents. Misbehavior slashes the bond on-chain. A cheap identity tide therefore buys nothing: to swing a quorum an attacker must lock real capital proportional to the influence sought, and forfeits it the moment peers detect collusion.
